hints.text: Your two developers are already on 1F. Press READY, then read the ledger at the bottom of the fight.
The shop restocks each round. REROLL replaces a tab's cards for ¥1 and never repeats one until the bag is empty.
Rooms are auras. Put an employee inside one and watch the badge appear.
Furniture affects its neighbours. Two juniors beside a whiteboard is a promotion.
Laying someone off costs severance. Flexibility is real. It is never free.
The Regional Rival is a competent copy of you. Read the ledger afterwards.
That was a lawyer. Legal makes Goodwill hard to break. There is a way around a balance sheet.
The B1 button is lit. The Agency does not haunt you. It invoices you.
